articles.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin president Matt Prusak departs for Giga Energy
articles.snippet: The executive is leaving the Eric Trump-backed miner to join an AI power infrastructure firm, highlighting the shift toward energy and data center buildout.

articles.title: U.S.-Japan intervention revives yen carry trade fears for bitcoin
articles.snippet: Coordinated action sent the yen sharply higher, but bitcoin’s recent correlation suggests U.S. dollar strength, rather than the carry trade, may be the bigger risk.

articles.title: Circle slides after Morgan Stanley downgrade, cut in price target
articles.snippet: The bank said tokenized money market funds, Open USD and slower USDC growth could weigh on the stablecoin issuer's earnings.

articles.title: Bernstein sees another leg lower for crypto markets if Clarity Act stalls
articles.snippet: The broker said failure to pass the Clarity Act this year would likely send crypto lower, but expects U.S. regulators to accelerate rulemaking.

articles.title: BlackRock expands tokenized cash with new blockchain-based money market offerings
articles.snippet: Both funds intend to qualify as eligible reserve assets for permitted U.S. payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act.
